title: The Admiral's Challenge
intro_text: Your victories have drawn the attention of the enemy's most feared admiral.
He commands a powerful armada of elite warships.
This is no ordinary battle - this is a test of supreme naval mastery.
The enemy admiral is a tactical genius with decades of experience.
His fleet moves with perfect coordination.
Every captain under his command is a veteran of countless battles.
Objective: Sink the enemy flagship and destroy his elite fleet.
Only the most skilled tactician will emerge victorious.
victory_text: The enemy admiral's flagship sinks beneath the waves!
His elite armada has been utterly destroyed.
You have achieved what many thought impossible.
The most feared naval commander has been defeated.
Your name will echo through history.
You are now recognized as the supreme master of naval warfare!
The Caribbean seas bow to your command, Admiral.
defeat_text: Defeat at the hands of a master.
The enemy admiral's tactical superiority was evident.
Your fleet has been outmaneuvered and outfought.
Perhaps you are not yet ready for this challenge.
Study naval tactics further and return when prepared.

title: Fortress Bombardment
intro_text: The enemy has fortified the harbor with coastal structures.
A naval fort, shipyard, and coastal batteries block your approach.
Use concentrated bombardment to breach their defenses.
victory_text: Success! The fortifications have been destroyed.
You have mastered naval siege warfare.
Enemy coastal defenses are no longer an obstacle.
defeat_text: Coastal structures require sustained naval bombardment.
